text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown refines her strategy heading 
into the Japan Cup. The one she must watch 
out for is Cheval Grand, who has begun to 
show a true will to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand was also acutely aware. 
Satono Crown was the "greatest" Umamusume 
of this era... which was precisely why she 
wanted to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Race day. Kitasan Black and Cheval Grand 
declare war on Satono Crown. There are 
many others aiming to topple Satono Crown 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown is ready to take on all of 
those challenges. All to make the Satono 
name echo across the world—!
